findings.title: Timeline inconsistency between run date and task deadline
findings.detail: The summary states the run is 30 days after kickoff, but the task list requires everything to be done five weeks (35 days) after kickoff. The notes also instruct to record the deadline as day 99.
findings.quote: The run is on a Sunday morning, 30 days after kickoff.

findings.title: Contradiction between course approval and insurance sequencing
findings.detail: The table lists course approval as waiting for event insurance, but the notes state insurance is taken out only after council approval of the course.
findings.quote: Kerry will take out the event insurance once the council has approved the course, because the insurers want a copy of the approved course map before they will cover us.
